text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, spotted ya, Producer! Let's get right 
on it! 'Project Japan Hype-Up'☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Project Japan Hype-Up'— A project 
conceived by Daitaku Helios to bring hype 
to all of Japan through smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having been appointed Producer, I was 
scheduled to help with the project today, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We're filming hype videos!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, basically, we film videos of Helios 
smiling, make them go viral, and hit the 
trending page. That way, she can deliver 
smiles to people all over Japan, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that's why, let's go, Partner & 
Producer! Here we go☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Vroom-vroom! It's the Hype☆Helios 
Channel~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today's challenge is~ 'Karaoke Scoring: 
How High Can We Score While Smiling!?'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And the song is... the classic for any 
horse girl! 'Umapyoi Densetsu'! Music, 
start☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Umadacchi♪ Sukidacchi♪ Ahaha! What even is 
a dacchi, gahh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: H-Helios—!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah-hahahaha! Man, I laughed way too hard! 
Ahahahaha~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Today's challenge is~ 'Can We Watch a 
Tearjerker Movie While Keeping a Smile!?' 
Let's get right into this trending movie, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, mnngh... He ended up all alone... 
...Poor grandpa... Ah, wait...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! The frog came back~~! The bond 
between grandpa and frog is so unreal~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't we just get some hilarious footage? 
Alright, cut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Edit it with the app and... posted! All 
that's left is to see how far the views 
climb, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? It already hit three digits 
in seconds!? And the comments... are 
insane! Everyone says it's making them 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Wait, I'm getting all emotional! 
Palmer, Producer, onto the next one, next 
one~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reaction to Daitaku Helios's videos 
was sensational, hitting a million views 
within that very day. What's more, the 
buzz didn't stop there. A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
OMG OMG CRAZY CRAZY!? Wh-What do I do, 
Paaaalmerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! Producer, super clutch encounter! 
What do I do, what do I dooo!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I got a DM from the staff of 'N.B.'!! They 
asked, 'Wanna guest appear in our Japan 
live show!?'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A-A famous overseas singer! Their first 
time touring in Japan is huge news right 
now...! Basically it's insane, all you 
gotta know is that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look look! They said my smile is wicked 
cool! Looks like they saw the video and 
sent the offer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I checked the message Daitaku Helios 
showed me, it was entirely written in 
English. There were some difficult words 
mixed in, but...
choice_data_list: Impressive that you can read English.
Impressive that you can read English.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No way I can! It's all vibes, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll work out somehow☆ So my reply 
is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, got a reply already! Hnnngh... Pretty 
sure it says 'Let's hype the floor up 
together'! Then my reply is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh! They sent 'GOOD'! Looks like they 
totally loved it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Helios's vibe can even cross 
national borders...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, at this point, forget Japan, isn't 
this 'Project WORLD Hype-Up'!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as the scale grew massive, the two 
remained completely unchanged. In a way, 
they might just be truly big stars in the 
making. ...I couldn't help but think that.
